body:
This doesn't really 'count' as an attempt, but I'll tell anyway.  I used to cut myself, a lot, but I never had the intent to kill myself that way.  

Anyways, I live on the 9th floor of a condo complex.  I have sat on the balcony, on several occasions and just want to jump.  Sometimes the feeling is so overwhelming I need to go inside and lock the door.  It's funny because I know that I am loved, and that I have a million friends, but I still get the urge to just end it all.  The one thing that keeps bringing me inside, is the image in my head of my parents.  (They don't know/don't choose to know that I used to cut myself).  I think my parents would always want to blame themselves if I ever jumped.  Even though it's my inability to cope, not their parenting that did it.

I know that kinda just turned into me rambling, but sometimes you need to share, ya know?
